senses.gloss: गोषुयुध् गोषुयुध्, i. e. गो + सु-युध्, adj. Contending for cattle, Chr. 297, 22 = Rigv. i. 112, 22.
† गोष्ट् गोष्ट्, i. 1, Ātm. To assemble (probably better गोष्ठ्; cf. the next.)

गोष्ठ गोष्ठ, i. e. गो-स्थ,
 I. m. and n.
 1. A pasture ground, a cow-pen, Man. 11, 108; MBh. 1, 7338.
 2. A stable, Man. 4, 58.
 3. Stay, abode, MBh. 3, 12341; सिंह-, a lion's den, Draup. 4, 9.
 4. Family, Man. 3, 254.
 5. A name of Śiva, MBh. 14, 198.
 II. f. ष्ठी,
 1. An assembly, MBh. 4, 891.
 2. Fellowship, MBh. 6, 3321.
 3. Conversation, Bhartṛ. 1, 35; Pañc. 31, 4.
 4. A kind of drama, Sāh. D. 541.
 --Comp.
गोष्ठि गोष्ठि, probably for गोष्ठी (see गोष्ठ), MBh. 5, 1536.
गोष्ठिक गोष्ठिक, i. e. गोष्ठी + इक, adj. Referring to a company, Pañc. i. d. 14.
गोष्ठेशय गोष्ठेशय, i. e. गोष्ठ + इ-शी + अ, adj. Sleeping in a cow-pen, Yājñ. 3, 263.

गोष्पद गोष्पद, i. e. गो + अस्-पद, n.
 1. The impression of a cow's foot, MBh. i. 1444.
 2. A puddle not larger than a cow's foot, Rām. 6, 69, 16.
 --Comp.
गोसंख्यातृ गोसंख्यातृ, i. e. गो-सम्-ख्या + तृ, m. A cow herd, MBh. 4, 67.

गो- + शीर्ष गो- + शीर्ष,
 I. adj. shaped like a cow's head, MBh. 7, 8097.
 II. n. a kind of sandal, Rām. 4, 41, 59.
गो- + संख्य गो- + संख्य, m. a cowherd, MBh. 4, 284.
गो- + सव गो- + सव, m. a kind of sacrifice, Man. 11, 74.
गो- + स्वामिन् गो- + स्वामिन्, m. 1. the owner of cattle, Man. 8, 231. 2. a holy man, used after proper names, as a honorary title.
